texture-level: Indicates the smoothness or coarseness of a product, typically for nutritional food purées; e.g. Level 1 (puréed), Level 2 (minced)
theme: Describes the product's primary theme or motif, such as sport, space, or holidays
therapeutic-features: Lists additional therapeutic modalities integrated into the neck brace
therapeutic-swing-accessories-included: Lists additional hardware or accessories supplied with the swing
therapy-mode-supported: Lists the breathing-therapy algorithms the device can operate in, beyond standard APAP
therapy-temperature-type: Indicates whether the product provides heat therapy, cold therapy, or both
thermal-sensation: Describes the perceived temperature effect on the skin after application
thickness-type: Indicates the level of thickness for items, such as thin, medium, or thick
tingle-intensity: Describes the heat or tingle sensation level produced by the product when applied
tip-design: Specifies the type of tip on medical needles and syringes, such as luer lock or slip tip
tip-material: Specifies the material used in the product's tip, e.g. cotton, silicone
tip-style: Describes the design of the product's tip, e.g. angled, curved
toe-spacer-design: Describes the design of toe separators used in foot care, e.g. contoured, loop design
tool-utensil-material: Identifies the main material used in a tool or utensil, like stainless steel or teak wood
toothbrush-head-size: Defines the relative size of the brushing head to suit different mouth sizes and cleaning needs
toothbrush-head-type: Classifies the functional style of the head (e.g., whitening, gum care, kids)
toothpaste-type: Defines the specific function of toothpaste, such as anti-decay or whitening
toothpick-design: Specifies the form of toothpicks, such as round or flat
tracking-metrics: Specifies the health and fitness data monitored by the product, e.g. sleep, steps
transfer-aid-type: Classifies the style of aid, distinguishing rigid boards from flexible sheets and air-assisted mats
transfer-board-shape: Defines the geometric profile of the board or sheet, which influences transfer path and compatibility with different seating or bed heights
transfer-boards-surface-type: Specifies the surface texture of mobility transfer boards, e.g. padded, smooth
travel-pillow-features: Lists special functional characteristics, accessories, or design enhancements of the travel pillow
travel-pillow-shape: Describes the physical contour of travel pillows, such as J-shaped
tray-compatibility: Identifies the style of whitening tray or mouthpiece the case is designed to fit
treatment-method: Describes the mechanism or delivery technology the product uses to eliminate the lesion (e.g., cryotherapy, chemical acid, microneedle patch)
treatment-modes: Lists the functional modes the device supports (e.g., HR, SHR, SR)
treatment-objective: Defines the issue the product addresses, typically for personal care items; e.g. snoring, fever
treatment-target-area: Indicates whether the product is formulated for lashes, brows, or both
treatment-type: Specifies the method of treatment, typically for hair loss treatments; e.g. laser, topical
ultrasound-probe-type: Identifies design characteristics of the probe supplied with the monitor (e.g., waterproof, internal)
upholstery-material: Identifies the fabric used for upholstery, such as leather or velvet
usage-conditions: Specifies if the product is suitable for use in dry or wet conditions, typically for razors
usage-environment: Specifies where the tanning product is intended to be used
usage-frequency: Specifies the recommended frequency of product use, such as daily or weekly
usage-type: Specifies the product's intended use cycle, e.g. reusable, refillable
uv-blocking-class: Indicates the level of UV protection built into the contact lens as defined by ISO standards
uv-protection: Specifies the product's ability to block UV rays, typically for sunglasses; e.g. UV400
uva-protection-grade: Indicates the UVA protection rating of the product, commonly expressed as PA grades
vision-correction-type: Indicates the optical design intended to correct specific vision conditions
walker-brake-type: Describes the braking mechanism incorporated in the walker
walker-seat-type: Identifies whether the walker includes a seat and the seat's style
walker-type: Classifies the structural style and intended usage of the walker
walking-aid-tip-type: Specifies the style or technology of the cane's ground tip
water-flosser-modes: Lists the available cleaning modes the device can operate in
wear-schedule: Specifies the maximum approved consecutive wear duration for the lens before removal
weight-loss-mechanism: Identifies the primary physiological approach the supplement uses to support weight loss
weight-unit-supported: Defines the weight units a product uses for measurement, e.g. pounds, stones
wheel-type: Specifies the kind of wheel for cycling products, such as inflatable or solid
wheelchair-type: Distinguishes between different types of wheelchairs, e.g. electric, manual
width-adjustment: Indicates whether the equipment's width can be altered to fit different fixtures, beds, or users
wing-style: Indicates whether the pad includes stabilizing wings and, if so, what style
wipe-packaging: Defines the container or packaging style for wipes, e.g. refill pack, travel-sized
wipe-purpose: Identifies the primary intended use or benefit of the wipes
wood-finish: Describes the finishing treatment or construction method applied to wood products (e.g., solid wood, veneered, engineered, oiled, lacquered, painted)
